summary_1line: Sugriva recounts how his brother Bali pursued the demon Mayavi into a cave after a challenge, ordering Sugriva to guard the entrance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Under bright moonlight, Bali and Sugriva chase the fleeing demon Mayavi across the forest as he dives into a grass-hidden cavern.
At the cave mouth, the furious monkey king Bali commands Sugriva to stand guard before disappearing into the dark cavern after the demon.
